page.layout: Running head and page number at top (left: INVOCAT., right: SANCT., page number 249 at top right). Below: two parallel verse columns (left and right) forming the first block; then running text full width (Secreta prayer); then a heading "ALIVD:" followed by two parallel columns; then heading "GRADVALE:" followed by two parallel columns; then running text full width (Post communionem prayer) ending with a catchword-like signature "Q. 5." and the word "igne" at foot right.

main_text.p: Secreta: Sacrificium nostrum, quaesumus Domine, benignus intende, quod sicut beati Antonii precibus, cruciatus temporales sanare non desinis: ita erui misericorditer impetremus ab aeternis.
main_text.head: ALIVD:
GRADVALE:
main_text.p: Post communionem: Profit nobis, quaesumus Domine, ad salutem sacri muneris oblatio, per quam beati Antonii fulti suffragio, exemplo ipsius, omnia tela nequissimi ignea

page.notes: Verse columns are set in italic black letter-like type; some letters doubtful. The last word "ignea" is partly illegible in the scan and the page-foot signature "Q. 5." is uncertain. Several words in the verse columns are doubtful and may contain printing errors.
